quests.name: Wastewander Justice
quests.summary: Take down 10 Wastewander Bandits and Thieves east of Gadgetzan, then report back to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle.

quests.name: More Wastewander Justice
quests.summary: Take down 10 Wastewander Shadow Mages, 8 Wastewander Rogues, and 6 Wastewander Assassins for Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Screecher Spirits
quests.summary: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.

quests.name: Water Pouch Bounty
quests.summary: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Spigot Operator Luglunket in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Water Pouch Bounty
quests.summary: Back again, <name>?  If you have five more Wastewander water pouches, then I have a care package with your name on it!

quests.name: Deliver to MacKinley
quests.summary: Bring Stoley's Bottle to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Pirate Hats Ahoy!
quests.summary: Haughty Modiste wants you to collect 20 Southsea Pirate Hats and return them to her at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

quests.name: Ship Schedules
quests.summary: Report the Ship Schedules to an authority in Steamwheedle Port.

quests.name: Southsea Shakedown
quests.summary: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to kill 10 Southsea Pirates, 10 Southsea Freebooters, 10 Southsea Dock Workers and 10 Southsea Swashbucklers.

quests.name: Stoley's Debt

quests.name: Stoley's Shipment
quests.summary: Bring Stoley's Shipment to Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.

quests.name: WANTED: Andre Firebeard
quests.summary: Bring Andre's Head to Security Chief Bilgewhizzle in Steamwheedle Port.

quests.name: Another Power Source?
quests.summary: Bring 10 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan in exchange for another power source.

quests.name: Gadgetzan Water Survey
quests.summary: Use the untapped dowsing widget near the pool of water by Sandsorrow Watch.  Once you have collected the sample, return the tapped dowsing widget to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Into the Field
quests.summary: Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan about getting a power source for the testing kit.

quests.name: Slake That Thirst
quests.summary: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Tanaris Field Sampling
quests.summary: Acquire acceptable samples for 8 basilisks, 8 hyenas, and 8 scorpions.  Bring the testing kit back to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan before the power source runs out.

quests.name: WANTED: Caliph Scorpidsting
quests.summary: Bring the head of Caliph Scorpidsting to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Handle With Care
quests.summary: Bring the Carefully-packed Crate to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.

quests.name: Noxious Lair Investigation
quests.summary: Bring five Centipaar insect parts from the Noxious Lair to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: The Super Egg-O-Matic
quests.summary: The Super Egg-O-Matic is the latest of Curgle Cranklehop's inventions. It is quite an impressive piece of machinery.The Super Egg-O-Matic sputters wildly as you approach the control panel.

quests.name: Find OOX-17/TN!
quests.summary: Bring the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot.

quests.name: Gahz'ridian
quests.summary: Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.

quests.name: Insect Part Analysis
quests.summary: Check in Gadgetzan for Alchemist Pestlezugg and his analysis of the insect parts.

quests.name: Insect Part Analysis
quests.summary: Deliver the report to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.  Be sure he gives you a copy of the report, as Alchemist Pestlezugg has requested.

quests.name: Rescue OOX-17/TN!
quests.summary: Escort OOX-17/TN to Steamwheedle Port, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Rise of the Silithid
quests.summary: Take the report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: The Scrimshank Redemption
quests.summary: Discover the fate of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, and bring either him or his surveying equipment to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Delivery for Marin
quests.summary: Sprinkle wants to you take the Violet Powder to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: In Good Taste
quests.summary: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak with Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Noggenfogger Elixir
quests.summary: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak to him again after he creates his elixir.

quests.name: Rise of the Silithid
quests.summary: Take the Insect Analysis Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

quests.name: Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient
quests.summary: Sprinkle in Gadgetzan wants you to collect a Violet Tragan and return it to her.

quests.name: The Dunemaul Compound
quests.summary: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.

quests.name: The Thirsty Goblin
quests.summary: Collect a Laden Dew Gland and bring it to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: The Stone Watcher
quests.summary: Learn the purpose of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon, and then interact with the Uldum Pedestal in the Tanaris desert.

quests.name: Thistleshrub Valley
quests.summary: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.

quests.name: Tooga's Quest
quests.summary: Show Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.

quests.name: The Stone Circle
quests.summary: Retrieve the Stone Circle from Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

quests.name: Bungle in the Jungle
quests.summary: Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

quests.summary: Defeat the Gorishi Hive Queen once she is summoned.Bring the Gorishi Queen's Brain to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Super Sticky
quests.summary: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Fire Plume Forged
quests.summary: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater.  Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Fire Plume Forged
quests.summary: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater.  Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Hand of Rastakhan
quests.summary: Speak with Molthor in Stranglethorn.

quests.name: A Bad Egg
quests.summary: These are the eggs that cannot be saved -- they will never hatch.

quests.name: A Fine Egg
quests.summary: A fine egg is one that will, in ideal conditions, hatch free of the evil effects of the Gordunni ogres' incantations.

quests.name: A Portable Power Source
quests.summary: Find Magma Lord Bokk in the Burning Steppes, obtain his Magma Core and bring it to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: A Shifty Merchant
quests.summary: Search for an imp inside a cave at the entrance of Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, purchase a Fel Elemental Rod and return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: A Supernatural Device
quests.summary: Bring the Sealed Blood Container to Mux Manascrambler inside Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

quests.name: A Supernatural Device
quests.summary: Take the Sealed Venom Container to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: An Extraordinary Egg
quests.summary: I have seen very few eggs retrieved from Feralas in extraordinary condition. These are eggs of the rarest sort...

quests.name: An Ordinary Egg
quests.summary: Ordinary hippogryph eggs hatch about half the time. We do our best to nurture them and with a little luck, they will hatch.

quests.name: Decoy!
quests.summary: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to travel to Winterspring and place the Bag of Gold at the drop off point documented by the booknappers.

quests.name: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops
quests.summary: Dirge Quickcleave in Gadgetzan wants you to bring him 20 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 20 Deeprock Salt.

quests.name: Draconic for Dummies
quests.summary: Find Narain Soothfancy's book, buried on an island in the South Seas.

quests.name: Hunting for Ectoplasm
quests.summary: Use the Ectoplasmic Distiller near incorporeal undead to collect 12 Scorched Ectoplasms in Silithus, 12 Frozen Ectoplasms in Winterspring and 12 Stable Ectoplasms in the Eastern Plaguelands.  Bring them along with the Ectoplasmic Distiller back to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Love Song for Narain
quests.summary: Take Meridith's Love Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Never Ask Me About My Business
quests.summary: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to speak with Dirge Quickcleave in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: rAnS0m
quests.summary: Return the Ransom Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Return to Narain
quests.summary: Deliver the 500 Pound Chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Stewvul, Ex-B.F.F.
quests.summary: Narain Soothfancy wants you to find his ex-best friend forever (BFF), Stewvul, and take back the scrying goggles that Stewvul stole from him.

quests.name: The Changing of Paths - Conqueror No More
quests.summary: Champion, should you decide to walk another path, present me with your signet ring and a mountain of scarabs from our enemies in Ahn'Qiraj. A quest.

quests.name: The Changing of Paths - Invoker No More
quests.summary: Champion, should you decide to walk another path, present me with your signet ring and a mountain of scarabs from our enemies in Ahn'Qiraj. A quest.

quests.name: The Charge of the Dragonflights
quests.summary: Eranikus, Vaelastrasz, and Azuregos... No doubt you know of these dragons, mortal. It is no coincidence, then, that they have played such influential roles as watchers of our world.Unfortunately (and my own naivety is partially to blame) whether by agents of the Old Gods or betrayal by those that would call them friend, each guardian has fallen to tragedy. The extent of which has fueled my own distrust towards your kind.Seek them out... And <race>, prepare yourself for the worst.

quests.name: The Ectoplasmic Distiller
quests.summary: Return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan with 1 Delicate Arcanite Converter, 4 Greater Eternal Essence, 10 Stonescale Oil, 25 Volcanic Ash and 40 gold.

quests.name: The Good News and The Bad News
quests.summary: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to bring him 20 Arcanite Bars, 10 Elementium Ore, 10 Azerothian Diamonds, and 10 Blue Sapphires.

quests.name: The Grand Invoker
quests.summary: Never have I seen such tenacity! The Bronze Flight grants you one final enchantment. The Timeless One himself has requested it so!Hand me your signet ring so that I may make the necessary adjustments.

quests.name: The Isle of Dread!
quests.summary: Recover Lakmaeran's Carcass and 20 Chimaerok Tenderloins for Dirge Quickcleave in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Might of Kalimdor
quests.summary: A thousand years has passed and just as it was fated, one stands before me. One who shall lead their people to a new age.The Old God trembles, <name>. Oh yes, it fears your faith. Shatter the prophecy of C'Thun.It knows you come, champion - and with you comes the might of Kalimdor. You have only to let me know when you are prepared and I shall grant you the Scepter of the Shifting Sands.

quests.name: The Only Prescription
quests.summary: Recover the 8 lost chapters of Draconic for Dummies and combine them with the Magical Book Binding and return the completed book of Draconic for Dummies: Volume II to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Path of the Conqueror
quests.summary: Impressive, little one. You have gone through much trouble to gain the favor of the Bronze Flight. Your dedication is noted.The signet ring of the conqueror will greatly enhance your physical attacks.Be warned, once you have chosen your path, you will have no recourse should you change your mind.

quests.name: The Path of the Conqueror
quests.summary: Your continued defense of the children of Kalimdor has been acknowledged. Hand me your signet ring so that I may enhance its powers.

quests.name: The Path of the Conqueror
quests.summary: You honor my kind, <name>. Strike down the enemies of Kalimdor! Show them what it means to deface the land of eternal starlight.You have earned another enhancement. Hand me your signet ring so that I may bolster its power.

quests.name: The Path of the Conqueror
quests.summary: Dedication of this magnitude is a rarity. You have shown that your will is unfaltering, <name>. You shall be greatly rewarded for your stalwart watch over our world.Hand me your signet ring so that I may strengthen its enchantment.

quests.name: Translating the Ledger
quests.summary: First things first, <name>! We need to figure out what Azuregos wrote in this ledger.You say that he's told you to make an arcanite buoy and that this is the schematic? Strange that he would write this in Draconic. That old goat knows I can't read this nonsense.If this is going to work, I'm going to need my scrying goggles, a five hundred pound chicken and volume II of "Draconic for Dummies." Not necessarily in that order.

quests.name: War at Sea
quests.summary: You seek to befriend the goblins of Tanaris once again, <name>?  We're in need of materials for sails and guns to fight off our old enemies, the Bloodsail Buccaneers.  Bring me mageweave and strong flux and we'll be on our way to pardoning your trespasses.
